find: Find it on the shelves and bring it to the till.
got: Got it. Now to the till.
wrong: Not that one. Check the picture on the ticket.
basket: Two things this time. Bring both to the till.
one: One down. Now find the other one.
more: Not yet. They wanted two things.

served.fine: Handed over. The customer nods and heads out.
served.perfect: Handed over in a flash. The bell rings them out.

late: The customer gives up waiting and leaves.
